scope: Five UNIC crates 0.9.0; code MIT choice plus separate observed Unicode 10.0.0 data-license mapping. Preparation only, no final binary or legal attestation.

methodology.archive: Read cached .crate gzip/tar in memory, require regular contained entries, hash against current Cargo.lock, compare every entry with installed source. No extraction.
methodology.upstream: Fetch exact VCS commit raw URLs, compare original manifests and selected runtime source/table files byte-for-byte.
methodology.membership: Parse complete DerivedCoreProperties 10.0.0 ranges and four local generated range tables; compare 0x110000-byte membership vectors including absent codepoints.
methodology.license_choice: MIT selected for UNIC code according to original source headers and COPYRIGHT at both pins. Apache text not exported; no cumulative MIT-and-Apache choice.
methodology.network: HTTPS only; redirect:error, per-request AbortSignal 20 seconds and 2 MiB body cap. Downloads remain in memory until validated text exports.

current_terms.observed_mapping: Current official terms cover computer data files under Unicode Public and assign Unicode License v3 unless specific restrictions/permissions/licenses are identified. The inspected 10.0.0 ReadMe and DerivedCoreProperties headers refer to Unicode terms and contain no different named license.
section_references: 2.b: definition of Data Files, including https://www.unicode.org/Public/
3.c: Unicode License v3 assignment subject to more specific terms at release or in the data/documentation

unicode_data.selected_data_license: UNICODE LICENSE V3, current official text retrieved 2026-09-12; separate from UNIC MIT code
unicode_data.historical_limit: This does not establish which full Unicode license text was served in 2017/2019. The exported v3 text is a current mapping and is not represented as a file packaged with UNIC 0.9.0 or its pinned UCD mirror.
unicode_data.release_work_remaining: Include original MIT plus COPYRIGHT and source notices, and current Unicode v3 data notice in the actual release notice bundle; verify final selected build inputs/features and actual distribution.

limits: Historical Windows feature inventory reused without regeneration; input hashes recorded. No new build or EXE contents attestation.
No complete dependency, legal or release compliance conclusion.
Optional pattern tables and dev/test Unicode data were not compared to UCD property data; their archive bytes are merely recorded.
Original source copyright notices were retained including optional 2018 par_iter provenance; no invented combined copyright year.
No temp files, global installation, binary execution, source/lock/config edits or commits.
